facts.fact: Le Pays reports the AGEFAU director general saying the fund spent nearly FCFA 3.7 billion in 2018-2024 and projects of over FCFA 13.5 billion since 2025, over FCFA 17 billion in all, on school and training-centre access centres, Wi-Fi huts and equipment.

systems.country_label: Agence de Gestion du Fonds d'Accès universel

note: The spending is a cumulative figure by period, not a budget-year execution account, so no spent fact.
